subject: Sharding billing-api integration tests
body:
Hi Alice,

I noticed your commit to acme/billing-api that split the integration tests into 4 shards to speed up CI.

I'm offering a free 20-minute audit of revenue automation workflows, and billing is one place where faster, more reliable pipelines tend to matter.

Would it be useful if I took a look at yours? Happy to drop it if the timing is off.

Best,
Jordan

Deep Pimpale
Mumbai, India
